sar.narrative: On 2016-11-22, card C13487-K1 belonging to customer C13487 was identified with unauthorized activity. Flagged transaction 3478561 for $74.96 exhibited pattern characteristics of undocumented. Investigation revealed 1 suspicious transaction(s) totaling $74.96 USD. Activity originated via online channel using device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080). The cardholder did not authorize this activity and confirmed no legitimate relationship with the transactions. Evidence indicates intentional card compromise linked to 3 additional payment cards. The financial institution has blocked card C13487-K1 and placed all associated accounts under enhanced surveillance.
